subject.title: fix(message): ignore populated Telegram location on model sends

question: Can any direct or API Gateway client obtain the internal agent-runtime identity used to classify a `message.action` request as model-originated?
rationale: The branch intentionally relaxes a strict mixed-payload validation rule only for a trusted origin, and source review identifies the Gateway client identity as the enforcement point; maintainer knowledge of the connection/authentication contract is required to approve that boundary.

options.title: Confirm the private identity boundary
options.body: Confirm that only the agent runtime receives this identity, then retain the narrow model-origin Telegram normalization and merge after required checks finish.

options.title: Make origin explicit and non-forgeable
options.body: If external clients can obtain the identity, replace the classification with an authenticated internal-only origin mechanism and add a focused negative Gateway test.

options.title: Keep strict Gateway behavior
options.body: Normalize only the local model-tool route and leave Gateway mixed sends rejected if a safe Gateway distinction is not available.

recommendation.title: Confirm the private identity boundary
recommendation.body: Confirm that only the agent runtime receives this identity, then retain the narrow model-origin Telegram normalization and merge after required checks finish.
